chapter.verse: A kipatcil pana om, a thu ka zak khitsa uh, komau' mit tawh ka muh khitsa uh, enin komau' khut tawh ka lawn khitsa uh ahi nuntakna thu-
tua nuntakna hong kilangin ko zong mu-in a thu teci pangin note' kianga kong tangko uh ahi, Pa tawh a om, kote' kiangah zong hong kilang, tua tawntung nuntakna thu-

tua ka muh ka zak uh pen mah note' kiangah zong hong tangko ka hi uh hi. Tua pen note zong kote tawh kithuahin kikholhkhopna na neih theih nading uh ahi hi. Kote pen Pa tawh, a Tapa Jesu Khris tawh, a kikhawlkhawm takpi ka hi uh hi.
Tua hi a, komau' lungdamna a cingtaak theih nadingin hih thute hong gelh ka hi uh hi.
Ama' kiangpan za-in note' kiangah kong tangko uh thu in: Pasian pen khuavak hi a, ama' sungah khuamial themkhat zong om lo hi.
Amah tawh kikholhkhopna ka nei ci napi-in khuamial sungah i om leh zuau gen i hi a, thumaan thutak a nuntakpih lo i hi hi.
Ahi zongin amah khuavak ahih mah bangin khuavak sungah i kalsuan leh khatlekhat kikholhkhopna a nei i hi a, ama' Tapa Jesu Khris' sisan in mawhna khempeuh pan eite hong silsiang hi.
Mawhna ka nei kei uh hi, i cih leh eimahmah a kikhem i hi a, i sungah thumaan thutak a om lo ahi hi.
I mawhnate pulak lehang amah muanhuai-in thutang ahih manin i mawhnate hong maisak ding a, diklohna khempeuh pan hong silsiang ding hi.
Mawhna ka bawl kei uh hi, i cih leh amah zuauphuak a suaksak i hi a, i sungah ama' thu a om lo ahi hi.
